inclusionRules: All BodyParts3D 4.0 skeletal muscle organs / heads / zones that have unique OBJ files, grouped by muscle (laterality merged; named heads concatenated). Excluded: extraocular, tongue, palate, pharynx, larynx, facial expression, abstract compartment parents. Latissimus dorsi and rectus abdominis have no BP3D 4.0 mesh and remain landmark-anchored synthetics. Iliacus + psoas major are merged as iliopsoas. Fiber axis = PCA of patient-right (x≤0) vertices.
